newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria plans to offer road building concessions.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria plans to offer road building concessions.

text.p: Bulgaria's interim cabinet plans to offer concession deals for building two stretches of international road corridors totalling 350 km in length, a cabinet spokesman said on Thursday.
"The cabinet asked the transport minister to prepare a proposal for offering concession rights on two road stretches," the spokesman told reporters.
The two stretches, in southern and eastern Bulgaria, would link Sofia and the second biggest city of Plovdiv with the Black Sea ports of Varna and Bourgas.

When completed they would become part of an international road corridor linking southern Italian ports via Durres in Albania and Macedonia with Turkey, and via Bourgas and Varna with the former Soviet republics.
"Road concessions could provide much needed investment for both projects and for maintaining local road infrastructure," the spokesman said. -- Sofia Newsroom +359-2 981 8569
